evidence_origin: User-supplied cluster output from freeze status files, split manifests, raw manifests and filter_decisions.json. Counts are transcribed, not independently recomputed from raw Jira records on this Mac.
source_selection_rule: Exclude sources with fewer than 100 original candidates: Qt 86, JiraEcosystem 23, Jira 3, Sakai 2.

filter_interpretation.jira_unavailable: Explicitly approved collection exclusions, before preprocessing. MongoDB: one issue returned 401. RedHat: 324 returned 404 (not found or not visible, not proof of deletion).
filter_interpretation.no_sprint_entry: No usable sprint-entry timestamp could be derived from sprint fields/change history on or after issue creation.
filter_interpretation.no_comment_before_sprint: No comment with a valid timestamp on or before the derived sprint-entry time. Includes no comments and comments only after entry. This is a retained study eligibility rule, not an inherent requirement for code-smell prediction.
filter_interpretation.unreconstructable_pre_sprint_metadata: The preparation step could not reconstruct required pre-sprint metadata from the available history.
filter_interpretation.accepted: Passed Jira preprocessing and pre-sprint reconstruction. These rows have frozen features and split membership, not yet verified code-smell labels.

counting_rule: One decision per selected candidate. The first failed gate is recorded; counts are mutually exclusive, not the total number of all conditions each issue violates.
remaining_work: Fetch linked code, establish complete supported detector coverage, generate labels, then determine final model eligibility. No real code-smell model results or class balance are available yet.
